{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensyno Station''' was a stop along the famed [[Vohai Unirail]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vohai]]. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the crew of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] assigned to the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] arranged to meet [[black marketeer]] [[Burgo Teage]] at the station. [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] [[operative]]s [[Cryle Cavv]] and [[Sienn Sconn]] planned to use the meeting as an opportunity to discover the location of the ''Guardian''.<ref name="TFO">{{JournalCite|15|Two for One}}</ref>
